_readme: Per-photo alt text for the gallery, in every site language.
tools/build-site.js reads this when it pre-renders gallery.html, so each
photo gets a description of what is actually in it instead of 38 copies of
'Apartment interior'. The build appends a location suffix (see SUFFIX in
build-site.js), so keep these phrases short and specific.
Any photo missing from this file falls back to the grid's generic
data-gallery-alt, so adding new photos never breaks the build.
